Primary subject: one thin, sinewy nonhuman forest creature, a small crouched physical membranous animal rather than a human ghost or a tree monster. Slender angular torso, narrow nonhuman head and dark unlit eyes, short plain mouth opening, thin elongated bent limbs ending in modest gripping digits. Thin folded dry leathery membrane sheets connect limbs to body; an obvious taut throat membrane faces toward the adjacent hollow cavity. No fur bulk, no clothing or human face. Full body clearly shown outside the opening, both lower gripping feet visible. It uses the hollow as a sound resonator rather than wearing wood as armor.
Required resonator attachment: ONLY one narrow compact hollow rotten trunk segment directly beside/behind the body, with a clearly visible dark natural oval hollow mouth and a few fibrous ties of the creature's dry membrane connecting at its rim. This tiny bark-lined hollow segment is the minimum physical component necessary to show the card; no complete tree, canopy, branches, roots, stump ground platform or forest vignette. The creature and narrow hollow together remain one compact readable sprite silhouette. No sound rings, music notes or drawn spoken words.
Composition: fixed elevated three-quarter view, head and crouched body facing screen UPPER-RIGHT along ground diagonal; unmirrored upper-left light. Entire head, limbs, feet, membranes and hollow component visible with generous clear margins. Main figure fully visible rather than hidden inside trunk. Compact distinct silhouette readable beside an 80px human at 1440x900. Membrane edges drawn crisply, not as smoke or ethereal mist.
Style: irregular dark ink contours, internal hatching, flat matte wash, strong shadow masses. Weathered dry membrane and bark rendered in muted soot, slate, umber and restrained ochre. Serious grounded dark fantasy with credible physical attachment and anatomy, same art set as references. No bright pale luminous ghost, glossy 3D render or soft painterly blur.
Backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha, fully empty outside subject and required hollow segment. No terrain tile, pedestal, earth, moss/grass patch, landscape, contact/cast shadow, dust or lighting halo.
Constraints: exactly one nonhuman creature; no human-copy ghost, invented biography, witness imagery, aura, symbols, runes, magic, glowing eyes, horns, huge fangs, armor, weapons, extra creatures, text, border or watermark. No animation or sprite sheet. Preserve full silhouette without cropping.
